MU.title_zh: 财报会前核对：Q4 毛利加速与下一季指引
MU.user_request: I am preparing a Micron earnings briefing. Reconstruct Q4 from the annual and nine-month filings, reconcile it to the earnings release, then test whether the next-quarter guidance meets my stated revenue and gross-margin hurdles.
MU.scope: FY2025 annual/Q3/Q4 and FY2026 Q1 guidance as announced 2025-09-23

steps.title_zh: 建立年度毛利基线
年度减累计反推 Q4
与业绩附件对账
指引区间相对实际季度的增长
按用户双门槛形成简报结论

STX.title_zh: 现金股息承受力：从已实现现金流到压力测试
STX.user_request: I want a Seagate dividend-coverage workpaper. Establish annual cash generation, compare actual dividends, estimate the newly declared dividend run rate, and stress-test it without treating my assumptions as company guidance.
STX.scope: FY2025 ended 2025-06-27; dividend announced 2025-07-29; explicit hypothetical stress

steps.title_zh: 取得现金流输入并计算 FCF
检验已支付股息覆盖
估算新股息的全年现金负担
现金流下降 15% 的覆盖压力
求最大可承受回撤并核对压力结果

WDC.title_zh: 分拆后的盈利口径与季度利润桥
WDC.user_request: I am reconciling Western Digital earnings after the Sandisk separation. Establish the correct continuing-operations boundary, bridge total and continuing profit, then check whether Q4 continuing net margin improved from Q3.

steps.title_zh: 先确定分拆后的口径
按上一步口径取年度财务基线
年度总利润桥接到持续经营
把 Q3 与年度持续经营基线对齐
用 Q4 业绩附件完成季度趋势判断

SNDK.title_zh: 扭亏核验：减值消退还是经营改善
SNDK.user_request: I am checking whether Sandisk's apparent Q4 recovery reflects underlying operating improvement or a disappearing goodwill charge, and whether the next-quarter release actually confirms a GAAP EPS turnaround.
SNDK.scope: FY2025 Q3/Q4, FY2025 annual impairment, FY2026 Q1 guidance issued 2025-08-14

steps.title_zh: 建立 Q3 亏损基线
只加回商誉减值
将 Q4 与原始及调整后 Q3 对比
验证全年减值并量化利润桥
缺失 GAAP 指引时不宣称确认扭亏

NTAP.title_zh: 资本回报预算：回购节奏与现金自给分开看
NTAP.user_request: I am reviewing NetApp's capital-return budget. Determine whether dividends and buybacks were funded by simple FCF, set a no-external-funding buyback limit, then distinguish quarterly budget pacing from actual cash coverage.
NTAP.scope: FY2025 ended 2025-04-25 and FY2026 Q1 ended 2025-07-25; explicit budget assumptions

steps.title_zh: 年度现金生成基线
对账年度分红与回购
在现金自给规则下反推回购额度
将年度预算与首季实际现金流对照
形成双重约束下的资本回报结论

PSTG.company: Pure Storage, Inc. (name and ticker in the pinned filing)
PSTG.title_zh: 订阅转型复盘：收入结构是否转化为毛利增长
PSTG.user_request: I am preparing a Pure Storage subscription-transition review using its FY2025 filing. Trace revenue mix, category growth and category gross profit, then determine which business actually supplied the increase in total gross profit.
PSTG.scope: Pure Storage name/PSTG ticker as reported; FY2025 ended 2025-02-02 and FY2024 comparative

steps.title_zh: 从维度数据取得产品与订阅营收
对账收入结构并计算订阅占比
把占比变化拆成两类收入增长
检查增长更快的业务是否毛利更高
完成毛利增长贡献桥

RMBS.title_zh: 收入质量复核：GAAP royalties 与 licensing billings
RMBS.user_request: I am reviewing Rambus's Q1 2025 growth and a proposed Q2 revenue estimate. Check the GAAP revenue bridge, test whether licensing billings are interchangeable with royalties, and decide if adding the outlook components produces valid GAAP revenue guidance.
RMBS.scope: Q1 2025/2024 comparatives; Q2 2025 outlook in 8-K dated 2025-04-28

steps.title_zh: 建立 GAAP 收入桥输入
将总收入增长拆到组成项目
检验 billings 是否跟随 royalties
用披露定义解释不可互换的指标
避免把指引组成项错误相加为 GAAP 收入
